title: Description is confusing/misleading
text: Description is confusing/misleading. The items themselves ONE chain, ONE ant moat and ONE cleaning brush are fine. The description seemed to imply that there were three sets of each - that’s not the case. There is a single set of three for the price. 5 stars for the merchandise, 2 stars off for a confusing, possibly misleading description.
